year_selection: Symmetric three-year spacing around the previously examined 2050, chosen before scoring the additional years.
forcing: Area- and calendar-day-weighted global annual tas averaged over the 35 training members of SSP2-4.5, relative to their published 1850–1900 reference.
wind_reference: Drive the same synthetic TC model with daily MPI winds and monthly MPI thermodynamics for each of the eight held-out members.
primary: Pooled six-new-year Wasserstein-1 distance of first-to-48h displacement to the MPI-driven reference, using the fixed monthly MPI background. The contrast is Research error minus v1 error in km.
secondary: Per-year and pooled including 2050; warming-only LIM; matched and native Fourier; lifetime peak-wind W1, formation and landfall count errors per 100 proposed disturbances.
uncertainty: Paired two-axis bootstrap of whole years and whole MPI members. A single-year interval resamples members. Keep all months, start dates, disturbances and driver outcomes together.
